exposed.name: EXPOSED
exposed.narrative: The evidence reaches a journalist with a clean chain of events attached. By morning the official story is already falling apart, and nobody on the crew knows who talked.

leaked.name: LEAKED
leaked.narrative: Something gets out. It is enough to raise questions, but the story has holes, and the people who wrote the cover-up are already patching them.

buried.name: BURIED
buried.narrative: The scene burns clean. Whatever happened here now only exists in your memory, and memory is not evidence.

caught.name: CAUGHT
caught.narrative: Rook makes the call. Your bag is searched in the van, and the evidence burns with everything else. You will not be on the next job.

campaign.name: THE WHISTLEBLOWER
campaign.narrative: Two cover-ups, two leaks the agency cannot explain. The inquiry is public now. Somewhere in the crew is the reason why, and they never found you.

campaign.name: MARKED
campaign.narrative: The truth got out, but so did your name. Rook stops talking to you. Your next assignment is a one-way trip.

campaign.name: UNDER WATCH
campaign.narrative: Too many questions, too little to show for them. You are moved to a desk job, with a camera pointed at it.

campaign.name: THE CLEANER
campaign.narrative: The crew trusts you completely. Every scene burned, every story held. You are very good at this job, and that is the problem.
